name: Seed league
source: App league; judged from the recorded rosters and this league's own rules, never from MFL
counting: Committed salary counts active salaries, IR and taxi at the league's shares, plus signed salary adjustments and dead money. Each counted salary and charge is rounded to the league's money increment. Negative cap room is the amount over the cap.
